scope: 40 synthetic-memory queries and 40 public Chinese queries; exact cosine; independently rebuilt indexes; default ONNX thread settings except explicit 2-thread runs. RSS before indexing excludes corpus vectors; active RSS includes the harness. Not production or a full MTEB result.

jina.scope: Existing service imports + real embedding adapter. No database/server startup, LLM extraction, mem0 hybrid ranking, production memories or WAN latency. RSS includes one-text inference, retained corpus vectors and benchmark harness.

dataset.memory: Hand-labelled diagnostic memory retrieval cases. Synthetic facts; not production memory or a representative quality benchmark.
dataset.public: C-MTEB/T2Reranking, dev rows 0-39, all positive passages and the first six negative passages per query, pooled into one corpus
